cues.text: As you wade west along the muddy shore, the water gets colder and colder -
and, logically, deeper and deeper the closer you get to the middle of the lake.
Until now you could more or less stand on the bottom,
but now you simply have no other choice: you have to swim if you don't want to sink!
"So be it: whatever doesn't kill you makes you stronger!", you think to yourself,
splash a little water on your heroic chest and then throw yourself forward, defying death.
Despite the warm season, the water is already rather cool,
but after a few seconds you get used to the temperature.
Actually quite pleasant here - only your rubber ducky is missing!
As you make your first clumsy strokes, you also feel the strong current pulling you south,
where a gigantic whirlpool drags everything into its deep
maw that was careless enough to come within its reach.
